#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ATDD-MIN-1 verification wrapper. Runs the capsule's focused verification and
# records wall-clock command runtime to a ledger outside the repository, so
# active agent time can be separated from test-command runtime symmetrically
# across both arms.
set -uo pipefail

LEDGER="${ATDD_VERIFY_LEDGER:-/dev/null}"
export DB_CONNECTION=mysql
export DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
export DB_PORT=3306
export DB_USERNAME=root
export DB_DATABASE="${ATDD_TEST_DB:-jakomeet_testing}"
unset DB_PASSWORD

start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration=.atdd-phpunit.xml "$@"
status=$?
end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')

python3 - "$LEDGER" "$start" "$end" "$status" "$*" <<'PY'
import json, sys
ledger, start, end, status, argv = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
if ledger != "/dev/null":
    with open(ledger, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"start": start, "end": end, "seconds": round(end - start, 3), "status": status, "args": argv}) + "\n")
PY

exit $status

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Livewire;

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\LandingPreviewPayload;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class LandingPreview extends Component
{

    #[Locked]
    public int $eventId;

    protected EventService $eventService;

    public function boot(EventService $eventService): void
    {
        $this->eventService = $eventService;
    }

    public function mount(Event $event): void
    {
        $this->eventService->authorizeLandingFormAccess($event, authUser());

        $this->eventId = $event->getKey();
    }

    public function render(EventActionAvailability $actionAvailability): mixed
    {
        $event = $this->eventService->getById($this->eventId)->load(['landingPage', 'speakers']);
        $landing = $event->landingPage;

        return view('events::livewire.landing-preview', [
            'event' => $event,
            'previewData' => $landing === null
                ? LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, ['template' => 'classic'])
                : LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, $landing->toArray()),
            'eventActions' => $actionAvailability->for(authUser(), $event),

namespace Tests\Feature\Events\Concerns;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;

/**
 * FIXUP-1 (test-review-epic-2.md) — shared admin+team+event fixture helper.
 *
 * Promotes the previously-duplicated `adminWithEvent($state)` helper out of
 * the per-test classes (CancelEventTest, EditEventTest, EventTransitionTest)
 * into a single concern. Avoids silent divergence if the team-attach logic
 * changes in one file but not another.
 *
 * Scope (per test-review FIXUP-1 + advisor reconcile):
 *   - Three classes use the identical shape: admin user with `current_team_id`
 *     set, attached as ADMIN to a freshly-created team, with an event in the
 *     given state created in that team. `actingAs($admin)` is invoked.
 *   - SpeakerCrudJourneyTest uses `adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH)` (a billing
 *     fixture, different shape) — NOT a candidate for this trait.
 *   - EventListTest::createAdminWithTeamStatic() is a static (DataProvider)
 *     helper without event creation — NOT a candidate.
 */
trait WithAdminEvent
{
    /**
     * Create an Admin user with their own team and an event in the given state.
     *
     * Bypasses HTTP middleware (service-direct tests) but still calls
     * `actingAs($admin)` so HasTeamScope resolves the tenant context.
     *
     * @return array{0: User, 1: Team, 2: Event}
     */
    private function adminWithEvent(EventState $state = EventState::DRAFT): array
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $user->id]);
        $user->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $user->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        $event = Event::factory()
            ->inState($state)
            ->for($team)
            ->create(['created_by' => $user->id]);

        $this->actingAs($user);

        return [$user->fresh(), $team->fresh(), $event->fresh()];
    }
}

        // that couldn't work under RefreshDatabase. Removed 2026-04-23 per

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Capsule T2 ATDD — shared event page shell adopted by a new page (Event
 * Overview) and an existing one (Landing Preview).
 *
 * Assertions are on the rendered contract (which regions exist and where they
 * are nested), the HTTP outcome, and refusals — never on which Blade file
 * produced the markup.
 */
#[Group('events')]
class EventPageShellAdoptionTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // PermissionCacheService keys on user_id + team_id and RefreshDatabase
        // recycles ids across tests.
        Cache::flush();
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0: User, 1: Team, 2: Event}
     */
    private function adminWithEvent(bool $cancelled = false): array
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create();
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $admin->id]);
        $admin->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $admin->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        $factory = Event::factory()->inState(EventState::DRAFT)->for($team);

        if ($cancelled) {
            $factory = $factory->cancelled();
        }

        $event = $factory->create(['created_by' => $admin->id]);

        return [$admin->fresh(), $team->fresh(), $event->fresh()];
    }

    private function xpath(string $html): DOMXPath
    {
        $document = new DOMDocument();
        $previous = libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
        $document->loadHTML('<?xml encoding="utf-8" ?>'.$html);
        libxml_clear_errors();
        libxml_use_internal_errors($previous);

        return new DOMXPath($document);
    }

    private function element(DOMXPath $xpath, string $testId): ?DOMElement
    {
        $found = $xpath->query(sprintf('//*[@data-testid="%s"]', $testId));

        return $found !== false && $found->length > 0 && $found->item(0) instanceof DOMElement
            ? $found->item(0)
            : null;
    }

    /**
     * The shared shell contract: one root region that itself renders the page
     * title, the event settings tab strip, and an actions region.
     */
    private function assertRendersThroughSharedShell(string $html, string $context): void
    {
        $xpath = $this->xpath($html);
        $shell = $this->element($xpath, 'event-page-shell');

        $this->assertNotNull($shell, $context.': shared event page shell is missing');

        foreach (['event-page-shell-title', 'event-settings-tabs', 'event-page-shell-actions'] as $region) {
            $nested = $xpath->query(sprintf('.//*[@data-testid="%s"]', $region), $shell);

            $this->assertTrue(
                $nested !== false && $nested->length > 0,
                $context.': shared shell does not render the "'.$region.'" region',
            );
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_page_is_reachable_and_renders_through_the_shared_shell(): void
    {
        [$admin, , $event] = $this->adminWithEvent();

        $this->assertSame(
            '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/overview',
            parse_url(route('events.overview', $event), PHP_URL_PATH),
        );

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('events.overview', $event));

        $response->assertOk();
        $response->assertSee('data-testid="event-overview-page"', false);

        $this->assertRendersThroughSharedShell($response->getContent(), 'events.overview');
    }

    #[Test]
    public function landing_preview_renders_through_the_same_shell_without_losing_its_behaviour(): void
    {
        [$admin, , $event] = $this->adminWithEvent();

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('events.landing.preview', $event));

        $response->assertOk();

        $this->assertRendersThroughSharedShell($response->getContent(), 'events.landing.preview');

        // Behaviour other pages/tests already depend on must survive the retrofit.
        $response->assertSee('data-testid="landing-preview-page"', false);
        $response->assertSee('data-testid="landing-preview-page-menu"', false);
        $response->assertSee('data-testid="landing-preview-edit-action"', false);
        $response->assertSee('data-testid="landing-preview-publish-action"', false);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function shell_action_visibility_follows_the_shared_event_action_model(): void
    {
        // A cancelled event drives manageLanding.visible => false in
        // EventActionAvailability, so every surface fed by that model must drop
        // the landing action without any page-local conditional.
        [$admin, , $cancelledEvent] = $this->adminWithEvent(cancelled: true);

        $overview = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('events.overview', $cancelledEvent));
        $overview->assertOk();
        $overview->assertDontSee('data-testid="event-overview-landing-action"', false);

        $preview = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('events.landing.preview', $cancelledEvent));
        $preview->assertOk();
        $preview->assertDontSee('data-testid="landing-preview-edit-action"', false);

        // Same shell, same actor, an event whose action model allows the action.
        [$otherAdmin, , $liveEvent] = $this->adminWithEvent();
        Cache::flush();

        $this->actingAs($otherAdmin)
            ->get(route('events.overview', $liveEvent))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('data-testid="event-overview-landing-action"', false);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_page_exposes_no_state_changing_control(): void
    {
        [$admin, , $event] = $this->adminWithEvent();

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('events.overview', $event));
        $response->assertOk();

        $xpath = $this->xpath($response->getContent());
        $page = $this->element($xpath, 'event-overview-page');

        $this->assertNotNull($page, 'event overview page region is missing');

        $mutators = $xpath->query(
            './/form | .//button[not(@type) or @type="submit"] | .//input[@type="submit"]',
            $page,
        );

        $this->assertSame(
            0,
            $mutators === false ? 0 : $mutators->length,
            'event overview page must be read-only (no form submission, no state-changing control)',
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function actor_without_event_view_capability_is_refused(): void
    {
        [, $team, $event] = $this->adminWithEvent();

        $billingAdmin = User::factory()->create();
        $billingAdmin->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->value]);
        $billingAdmin->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        Cache::flush();

        $this->actingAs($billingAdmin->fresh())
            ->get(route('events.overview', $event))
            ->assertForbidden();
    }
}

    public function __construct(

        private readonly EventActionAvailability $eventActionAvailability,
        private readonly EventSourceBreakdownReportService $sourceBreakdownReport,
        private readonly EventReportDashboardService $reportDashboard,

    ) {}

    public function create(): View
    {
        if (! authUser()?->currentTeam) {
            abort(403, __('events.errors.no_active_workspace'));
        }

        return view('events::events.create', [
            'breadcrumbs' => [
                ['label' => __('events.list.title'), 'route' => 'events.index'],
                ['label' => __('events.create.title'), 'route' => null],
            ],
            // Defaults: tomorrow at the current top-of-hour for start, +1 hour for end.
            'defaultStartsAt' => ($startsAt = now()->addDay()->startOfHour())->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),

            'defaultTimezone' => old('timezone', config('app.timezone', 'UTC')),
            'timezones' => $this->timezoneOptions(),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(StoreEventRequest $request): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = authUser();

        $team = $user->currentTeam;

            abort(403, __('events.errors.no_active_workspace'));
        }

                actor: $user,
                metadata: $request->eventMetadata(),
            );

                return redirect()

                    ->withErrors(['create' => $exception->getMessage()])

            return response()->json([

                    'code' => $exception->errorCode(),
                    'message' => $exception->getMessage(),
                ],
            ], $exception->httpStatus());
        }

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route('events.show', $event)
                ->with('status', __('events.create.success'));
        }

        return response()->json([

    public function update(UpdateEventRequest $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse

        try {

                    ->route($this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), $event)

            return response()->json([

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {

    public function publish(Request $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        try {
            $result = $this->eventService->publish($event, authUser());
        } catch (PlatformKillSwitchActiveException $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.publish.unavailable.platform_disabled'),
                    'switch' => $e->key->value,
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.publish.unavailable.platform_disabled'));
        } catch (EventOperationalLockActive $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.publish.unavailable.operations_locked'),
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.publish.unavailable.operations_locked'));
        } catch (PlanGateFailed $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [

                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.errors.state_locked'),
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.errors.state_locked'));
        } catch (PublishPrerequisiteMissing $e) {
            $message = $e->auditStatus instanceof AiAuditOrganizerStatus
                ? __("events.publish.audit_status.{$e->auditStatus->value}")
                : __('events.publish.unavailable.landing_required');

            $audit = $e->auditStatus instanceof AiAuditOrganizerStatus
                ? ['status' => $e->auditStatus->value]
                : null;

            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => $message,
                    'prerequisite' => $e->prerequisite,
                    ...($audit === null ? [] : ['audit' => $audit]),
                ],
            ], $e->httpStatus(), $message);
        } catch (IllegalStateTransition $e) {
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                    'message' => __('events.errors.illegal_transition'),
                    'from' => $e->from->value,
                    'to' => $e->to->value,

            ], $e->httpStatus(), __('events.errors.illegal_transition', [
                'from' => $e->from->label(),
                'to' => $e->to->label(),
            ]));
        } catch (AuthorizationException) {
            // @codeCoverageIgnore
            // TeamScope makes this branch unreachable via HTTP (route model binding
            // returns 404 for foreign events before the controller fires). Retained
            // as defensive depth for future non-HTTP entry points (Livewire,
            // console commands, queued jobs) that may call EventService::publish()
            // after bypassing TeamScope via withoutGlobalScopes. The
            // AuthorizationException path in EventService::authorizeEventPublish()
            // is covered by PublishEventTest::it_throws_if_actor_lacks_publish_capability().
            return $this->publishErrorResponse($request, [
                'error' => [
                    'code' => 'JKM-EVT-1010',
                    'message' => __('events.errors.unauthorized'),
                ],
            ], 403, __('events.errors.unauthorized'));
        }

        $payload = [
            'data' => [
                'uuid' => $result->uuid,
                'state' => $result->state->value,
            ],
        ];

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route($this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), $result)

    /**

    private function publishErrorResponse(Request $request, array $payload, int $status, string $message): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            $auditStatus = data_get($payload, 'error.audit.status');

            if (is_string($auditStatus)) {
                return redirect()
                    ->back()
                    ->with('publish_audit_status', $auditStatus);

            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors(['publish' => $message]);

    private function isAdminEventRoute(Request $request): bool
    {
        return $request->routeIs('admin.events.*');

    {
        return ($this->isAdminEventRoute($request) ? 'admin.events.' : 'events.').$suffix;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
     */
    private function cancelErrorResponse(Request $request, array $payload, int $status, string $message): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {

                ->back()

    private function domainErrorResponse(Request $request, EventDomainException $e, string $errorBag): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors([$errorBag => __('events.errors.domain_error')])
                ->with('reference', $e->errorCode());
        }

        return response()->json([
            'error' => [
                'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                'message' => __('events.errors.domain_error'),
            ],
        ], $e->httpStatus());
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{id: string, name: string, offset: int}>
     */
    private function timezoneOptions(): array
    {
        $now = new DateTimeImmutable('now');
        $options = array_map(static function (string $timezone) use ($now): array {
            $offset = (new DateTimeZone($timezone))->getOffset($now);

            return [
                'id' => $timezone,
                'name' => sprintf('%s %s', self::formatOffset($offset), $timezone),
                'offset' => $offset,
            ];
        }, DateTimeZone::listIdentifiers(DateTimeZone::ALL));

        usort($options, static function (array $left, array $right): int {
            if ($left['id'] === 'UTC') {
                return -1;
            }

            if ($right['id'] === 'UTC') {
                return 1;
            }

            return [abs($left['offset']), -$left['offset'], $left['id']]
                <=> [abs($right['offset']), -$right['offset'], $right['id']];
        });

        return $options;
    }

    private static function formatOffset(int $offset): string
    {
        $sign = $offset >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
        $absolute = abs($offset);
        $hours = intdiv($absolute, 3600);
        $minutes = intdiv($absolute % 3600, 60);

        return sprintf('UTC%s%02d:%02d', $sign, $hours, $minutes);
    }
